reasoning: The question asks whether the 1-week compounded euro short-term average rate (ESTER) on 2026-10-18 will exceed its value on 2026-10-11. The evidence indicates the ECB held rates at 2.50% deposit rate as of September 16, 2026, with the next meeting on October 29. Multiple sources confirm economists expect rates to remain unchanged in October (70 of 73 economists) and only rise in December. Since no rate change is expected between October 11 and October 18, and ESTER closely tracks ECB policy rates, the 1-week compounded average rate should remain stable or very similar across these dates. The probability of exceeding (rather than equaling or being slightly lower due to technical factors) is low.
